description: This file defines a multi-root editor for CKEditor5, including classes for UI components and editor logic, with references to core modules and utilities.

classes.name: MultiRootEditor
classes.description: Main class for the multi-root CKEditor5 editor, managing multiple source roots and their attributes.

classes.name: MultiRootEditorUI
classes.description: UI class managing editor toolbars, editable areas, and menu bar.

classes.name: MultiRootEditorUIView
classes.description: View class handling the visual components of the editor UI, including editable regions and toolbars.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editor UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: addRoot
methods.description: Creates and attaches a new root element with optional data and attributes.

methods.name: detachRoot
methods.description: Detaches a root element from the editor.

methods.name: loadRoot
methods.description: Loads data into a specified root element.

methods.name: registerRootAttribute
methods.description: Registers a new attribute for root elements.

methods.name: enableRoot
methods.description: Removes read-only restriction from a root.
